correctness.rationale: The relation D(t^n)=n t^{n−1}D(t) makes f=D(t) unrestricted at even n but divisible by t at odd n. Writing f=a(t²)+t b(t²) or f=t²a(t²)+t b(t²), respectively, gives the same S² coordinate space. In char2, D² is again a derivation, and D²(t)=f f′, f′=b(t²), so D²=0 iff ab=b²=0 in S in either parity. Since b²=0 forces v_s(b)>=ceil(m/2), its b-valuation strata lie in closed linear subspaces L_j, none contained in another. All components have m dimensions, intersection L_j∩L_l dimension m−(l−j), consecutive additions count q^m−q^{m−1} new points, and the map on odd monomials gives rank m−min(v_s(a),v_s(b)). The acyclic rank m requires even n and unit a (hence b=0). Independent exhaustive coefficient equations in GF(2), m=1..6, gave 2,6,12,32,64,160 points and component counts 1,2,2,3,3,4. These finite checks do not substitute for symbolic all-field proof.
